ed74458a9f83b4c5.text: The cause is numerical, not structural: with dt = 0.25 months and capacity near 5000 patients a month, one Euler step takes more patients from a small band than it holds, so the band overshoots below zero before the shares in the Treating flows can respond. Halve the time step to 0.0625 months (or use RK4) and the bands will stay non-negative; the equations themselves need no change.
